details:
This update for apptainer fixes the following issues:

Changes in apptainer:

- Fix potential authentication bypass and deadlocks in the
  crypto/ssh library by updating golang.org/x/crypto to v0.56.0.
  CVE-2026-56854,CVE-2026-78662,CVE-2026-56855 (bsc#1278666)
- Fix
  * a potential DoS via crash due to missing ':authority' and
    'Host' headers in gRPC-Go xDS servers CVE-2026-84445 (bsc#1279033),
  * a potential heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame
     fragmentation CVE-2026-84304 (bsc#1279236),
  * a potential bypass of authorization policies via mixed-case
    or canonical-case header matches due to an xDS RBAC HTTP filter
    implementation issue CVE-2026-84303 (bsc#1279333)
  by updating google.golang.org/grpc to v1.83.2
